newFeatures: Crop and straighten (R): drag corners or edges, drag inside to move, drag outside to turn the photo under a level crop box. Enter applies, Esc cancels.
Crop aspects Original, 1:1, 4:5, 5:7, 2:3, 16:9 and Custom, with a lock; X swaps portrait and landscape; O cycles thirds, grid, golden ratio and diagonals.
Straighten with the Angle slider, or draw a level line along the horizon (the Level button, or Ctrl-drag while cropping).
Rotate left and right (Ctrl+[ and Ctrl+]) and flip horizontally or vertically.
The crop is used everywhere: histogram, Auto, thumbnails, Export, 100 % views, and Paste, Sync and presets (tick Crop to copy it).
Develop's tools are now one scrolling list with a jump bar (Crop, Basic); groups can be closed, and an eye shows the photo without a group.
Process versions: each edit remembers which version of LightBench's rendering it uses, so later changes never alter it until you choose “Update to current process”.
Back up the whole library (catalog, thumbnails and settings) to one checked file, and restore it safely.
LightBench notices when Lightroom, darktable or another app changes a photo's sidecar, and asks before overwriting it.
bugFixes: Star ratings changed in Lightroom or Bridge are no longer overridden when LightBench re-reads the sidecar.
Keywords that other apps store only as plain (flat) keywords are no longer dropped.
Photos copied from a card are now checked byte-for-byte; a bad copy is reported instead of being added.
A library saved by a newer LightBench is refused untouched, with a Reload button.
Notices when the browser may clear the library, or when a save fails.

newFeatures: Compare (C): the photo you like best stays on the left while the arrow keys bring in others to compare with it.
Survey (N): the selected photos side by side, to flag, rate and drop them until the best are left.
Metadata: edit title, caption, creator, copyright and location on one photo or many. They are saved in sidecars and included in exports.
Metadata presets (“© {year} Your Name” becomes each photo's year) that can fill in new photos, and import presets for the Import window's options.
Settings (the gear, or Ctrl+,): change any keyboard shortcut, or switch to Lightroom Classic's keys.
Press ? for the shortcuts of the current view, or Ctrl+Shift+P to find any action by name.
Interface size from 90 % to 150 % (Ctrl+Alt+= and Ctrl+Alt+−). Photos stay sharp.
Choose the background behind photos: black, dark grey or mid grey.
Develop sliders: arrow keys nudge, Shift+arrows take bigger steps, Home resets.
Install LightBench as an app from Chrome or Edge (the install button in the address bar).
Works offline after the first visit. Your photos and library were already stored on your computer.
An “Update ready” notice with these notes. Nothing changes until you click Reload.
Open RAW and JPEG files with the installed app from your file manager (Chrome and Edge).
Copy, paste and sync develop settings between photos, choosing which settings go. Auto can re-run on each photo.
Auto options: a strength slider and a choice of which sliders Auto may change.
Presets: save chosen settings, preview on hover, apply with an Amount, and develop new photos with one automatically.
